thread:
kari (CS): kicking off Seaforth private deploy day0. customer asks: CMK import, strict S3 endpoint policy (no internet egress), cross-account IAM role for redwood infra, and Flow Logs -> Splunk delivery within 30m. also they want an official runbook for audit evidence. can we triage?
sam (SRE): i reviewed their terraform plan. they created an interface endpoint for S3 (good) but haven't set the endpoint policy. also noticed they plan a single NAT for all AZs which could complicate static egress IP mapping.
zoe (Solutions): for CMK import we need wrapped key + import token. if legal gates the token, we can offer a temporary KMS-key we create and hand over admin perms later. pros/cons in a short note incoming.
mike (Seaforth): wrapped_key.bin uploaded to s3://seaforth-sec/keys/. legal is reviewing the amendment for token sharing, expected within 6 hours. renewal team flagged audit readiness as tied to discount.
rachel (AE): noting renewal sensitivity. if ingestion can't be validated within the committed window, procurement will re-open discount terms. marking potential renewal risk.
kari (CS): proposed P0 checklist: 1) CMK import validated, 2) cross-account assume-role tested, 3) endpoint policy locked to audit bucket, 4) Flow Logs smoke ingestion with >=95% <30m, 5) runbook + evidence link produced. agree?
sam (SRE): agreed. IAM trust snippet i'll run for assume-role test: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-priv"},"Action":["sts:AssumeRole"]}]
}
```
zoe (Solutions): endpoint policy template i'll paste after this thread. suggestion: condition on aws:sourceVpce and s3:prefix to limit writes to seaforth-audit/* only.
ops-bot: ticket SF-10101 created and assigned to sam, zoe -> https://tickets.internal/SF-10101 (automated)
mike (Seaforth): legal uploaded import_token.bin to the secure bucket: s3://seaforth-sec/keys/import_token.bin (access: seaforth/sec-team + redwood-priv-role).
sam (SRE): running import now, will post describe-key output.
sam (SRE): kms import completed, KeyState: Enabled. running assume-role test next.
sam (SRE): assume-role OK: "sts:AssumeRole succeeded for arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/redwood-priv"
zoe (Solutions): kicking Flow Logs harness: sending 600 events -> will monitor latency and percent under 30m. runbook will include Firehose config + S3 backup using imported CMK.
ops-bot: smoke-run SF-10101: 600 events sent, median latency 21s, 99% within 30m. telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/runs/SF-10101 (automated)
mike (Seaforth): Splunk confirmed receipt in index seaforth-prod and retention tags look correct. network will whitelist egress IPs after we provide them.
kari (CS): updating onboarding tracker: CMK import , IAM assume-role , endpoint policy applied , flow logs smoke pass . final action: mike to confirm whitelist and we'll attach the runbook + telemetry link to the week0 handoff.
rachel (AE): marking renewal risk mitigated pending whitelist. i'll follow up with procurement thread after whitelist confirmation. thanks team! :thumbsup:
